name: boringstack-docs
description: boringstack.xyz docs site for the BoringStack project. Astro Starlight, deployed via Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.generate:docs-data: bun run generate:lint-meta-docs && bun run generate:scripts-docs
scripts.check:docs-data: bun run check:lint-meta-docs && bun run check:scripts-docs
scripts.build:ci: bun run check:docs-data && bun run check:components && bun run generate:og-image && astro build && bun run check:fragments && bun run check:rendered-markdown

//overrides._: Why these transitive deps are pinned. Build-time/dev tooling only — the deployed site is static Cloudflare Pages. Re-evaluate quarterly (see osv-scanner.toml).
//overrides.adm-zip: Pin patched adm-zip (GHSA-xcpc-8h2w-3j85). 0.5.17 is vulnerable; 0.6.0 patches it. Build-time tooling only.
//overrides.axios: Pin patched axios (GHSA-gcfj-64vw-6mp9 and related). 1.16.1 is vulnerable; 1.18.0 patches it. Build-time tooling only.
//overrides.dompurify: Pin patched DOMPurify (GHSA-c2j3-45gr-mqc4). 3.4.7 is vulnerable; 3.4.12 patches it. Pulled via mermaid diagram rendering; diagram source is author-controlled.
//overrides.js-yaml: Pin patched js-yaml (GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m). 4.2.0 is vulnerable; 4.3.0 patches it. Build-time config loading only.
//overrides.postcss: Pin patched postcss (GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849). 8.5.16 is vulnerable; 8.5.18 patches it. Build-time CSS tooling via vite/tailwind.
//overrides.sharp: Collapse transitive sharp@0.34.5 (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj) onto the direct sharp@0.35.3 pin. Image processing at build time only.
//overrides.svgo: Pin patched svgo (GHSA-2p49-hgcm-8545). 4.0.1 is vulnerable; 4.0.2 patches it. SVG optimization at build time only.
//overrides.ws: Pin patched ws (GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx) pulled via miniflare/wrangler dev tooling.
//overrides.devalue: Pin patched devalue build-time serialization XSS (GHSA-77vg-94rm-hx3p).
//overrides.qs: Pin patched qs (GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26) pulled via the http-server dev preview tool.
//overrides.tmp: Pin patched tmp (GHSA-7c78-jf6q-g5cm type-confusion path traversal); 0.2.6 is now vulnerable, 0.2.7 patches it. Transitive dev-tooling dep. Mirrors the UI app pin.
//overrides.form-data: Pin patched form-data (GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx CRLF injection); 4.0.5 is vulnerable, 4.0.6 patches it. Build-time tooling only (wrangler/astro fetches). Mirrors the API app pin. Excluded from the install quarantine while <7 days old.
//overrides.undici: Pin patched undici (GHSA-vmh5-mc38-953g TLS cert-validation bypass, GHSA-pr7r-676h-xcf6); 7.28.0 patches it. Build-time tooling only (wrangler/astro fetches). Mirrors the UI app pin. Excluded from the install quarantine while <7 days old.
//overrides.@types/react: Match the UI app's @types/react pin so React types resolve identically across apps (@astrojs/react pulls them transitively here).
//overrides.@types/react-dom: Match the UI app's @types/react-dom pin for the same cross-app type parity.
//overrides.@astrojs/markdown-remark: Pin to astro 6.4.8's exact dependency. Starlight depends on the 7.1.x range transitively, but only 7.2.0 exposes the `unified` subpath export that astro 6.4.8's prerender runtime imports; without this the hoisted 7.1.x copy shadows astro's nested 7.2.0 and `astro build` fails. Re-evaluate when Starlight requires >=7.2.0.
